definition: An outdoor area where flowers, plants, or vegetables are grown.
clues: It can have paths, trees, and flower beds.
It may be public or part of a home.
It is a cultivated outdoor space.

definition: A structure built over a gap so people or vehicles can cross it.
clues: It connects two sides.
It may cross a river or a road.
It is a structure for crossing an obstacle.

definition: A large celestial body that orbits a star.
clues: It travels around a star.
Earth is one example.
It is a large celestial body orbiting a star.

definition: A small fabric pouch sewn into or attached to clothing or a bag.
clues: It is often found in trousers or jackets.
It can hold small everyday objects.
It is a small pouch attached to clothing.

definition: A portable light with a protective frame around its source.
clues: It can be carried by a handle.
Some versions use a candle; others use a battery.
It is a portable light inside a protective frame.

definition: A large area covered mainly with trees and other vegetation.
clues: It can be home to many kinds of wildlife.
It may contain trails and clearings.
It is a large area with many trees.

definition: An opening in a wall, usually fitted with glass, that lets in light and air.
clues: It can be opened to let in a breeze.
Curtains are often placed around it.
It is a glazed opening in a wall.

definition: An instrument that shows direction, often using a magnetic needle.
clues: It can help with navigation.
A traditional one points toward magnetic north.
It is an instrument for finding direction.

definition: A cylinder of wax with a wick that gives light when lit.
clues: It can be used during a power outage.
Its flame gets smaller as the material is consumed.
It is made of wax around a wick.

definition: A large piece of warm fabric used to cover a bed or a person.
clues: It can be folded at the foot of a bed.
People often use it on a cold night.
It is a warm covering made from fabric.

definition: A place where objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest are displayed.
clues: Visitors may see paintings or artifacts there.
Exhibits are often arranged by topic.
It is a place for displaying collections.

definition: A piece of land where fruit trees are grown.
clues: Rows of trees may grow there.
Apples or citrus fruits can come from one.
It is land planted with fruit trees.

definition: An arc of colors that can appear in the sky when sunlight meets water droplets.
clues: It may appear after rain.
Its colors are often remembered in a fixed sequence.
It is a multicolored arc in the sky.

definition: A bag carried on the back with shoulder straps.
clues: Students often carry one to school.
It leaves both hands free while being carried.
It is a bag worn on the back.

definition: A container used to heat water, often for tea or coffee.
clues: It may whistle when the water boils.
It can be electric or used on a stove.
It is a container for heating water.

definition: Travel from one place to another, especially over a considerable distance.
clues: It can involve more than one stop.
A map may help plan one.
It is travel from one place to another.
